candidate_lesson.context: FORGE-EXT-001 made one paid proposal-only Hallam request. The schema-valid response was refused during scope validation, but the retained outcome named only ValueError and the failed rule could not be reconstructed.
candidate_lesson.diagnosis: the execution strategy persisted too little safe refusal detail to attribute a post-schema rejection, so it blocked evidence-based recovery
failure_signatures: unexplained_proposal_refusal a code proposal refused retained rule safe schema valid without
candidate_lesson.intended_change: before a paid external Builder call, use independently audited allowlisted refusal reason codes and content-free hunk metadata, and scan credentials before any response-derived persistence
negative_knowledge: A generic exception type without the failed rule does not support attribution and must not justify blind retry.
